sn28.2:1.2: Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || disvāna āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam etad avoca || ||
sn28.2:1.3: Vippasannāni kho te avuso Sāriputta indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto ||
sn28.2:2.1: Idhāham āvuso vitakkavicārānam vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādānaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijam pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn28.2:2.2: tassa mayham āvuso na evaṃ hoti
sn28.2:2.3: Ahaṃ dutiyajjhānam samāpajjāmīti vā Ahaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpanno ti vā Aham dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhito ti vā ti || || 8
sn28.2:2.4: Tathā hi panāyasmato Sāriputtassa dīgharattam ahaṃkāra-mamaṃkāra-mānānusayā susamūhatā ||
sn28.2:2.5: tasmā āyasmato Sāriputtassa na evaṃ hoti
sn28.2:2.6: Ahaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā Ahaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpannoti vā Ahaṃ dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhito ti vā ti || || 1-6
